mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCOM_WISHLIST (WISHLIST_NO, ACCOMMODATION_NO, MEMBER_NO) VALUES (SEQ_ACCOM_WISHLIST_NO.NEXTVAL, #{accommodationNo}, #{memberNo})
mapper.select: SELECT A.ACCOMMODATION_NO AS "accommodationNo", A.NAME AS "name", A.REGION AS "region", A.ACCOMMODATION_TYPE AS "accommodationType", A.THUMBNAIL_URL AS "thumbnailUrl", A.PRICE_MIN AS "priceMin", W.CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" FROM ACCOM_WISHLIST W JOIN ACCOMMODATION A ON W.ACCOMMODATION_NO = A.ACCOMMODATION_NO WHERE W.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY W.CREATED_AT DESC
